The '''TeleSonic Model Audio Pickup''' was a basic [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio microphone]] that could detect noise at long ranges, filter out background noise and analyze common sounds. It could store 3 hours of recordings on a standard [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]]. It was often mounted inside helmets and was popular with members of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].
